system.requirement: Proficient in at least two of Culture, Performance or Persuasion
system.bonus: Whether it's hosting open mic night or just belting out a few tunes in the evening, your performances are well attended. When you spend your downtime in the Rec Hall, you may apply the Rec Hall bonus to a team member in addition to yourself. You may purchase this feat multiple times, providing the bonus to an additional team member each time.
